text:
celine: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a compatibility-first strategy to retire the old "transform-rpc" surface without breaking SDKs. Goal: allow clients to opt into v2 semantics while we pay down the legacy RPC layer over 6 months.
omar: +1. High-level idea: compatibility shim that accepts old RPC payloads, normalizes them to v2, and emits a deprecation header. Shim can run in front of v2 for the migration window.
peter: Questions: what about schema evolution for enums and optional fields? We need explicit mapping rules and a contract test matrix. Also who owns the shim? infra or runtime team?
celine: Proposal: ownership splits — infra owns the shim deployment and routing, runtime owns the normalization logic and contract tests. We'll treat the shim as a thin compatibility adapter, not business logic.
nav: For enums, we should implement tolerant parsing with a fallback-to-string mode and surface unknown values as deprecated-tags in telemetry. Also include a nightly job that reports unknown-value counts per tenant.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: compatibility-shim:canary deployed to staging -> 2 instances. Monitoring hooks: deprecation-header-rate, unknown-enum-count, p95-latency-delta.
qa-bot: QA: we'll need three contract test tiers: unit schema checks, semantic regression (prompt-driven), and cross-SDK integration tests. Recommend adding a pre-merge hook that runs the schema checks.
omar: Rollout safety: read-mirror for 48h, diff acceptance < 0.1% semantically; then opt-in gating: tenants can flip to v2 via a flag. After opt-in, we run a 7-day observation before marking as migrated.
peter: Deprecation timelines: soft deprecate for 90 days (warning headers + console banner), hard deprecate after 6 months for endpoints with zero opt-ins. For tenants that haven't opted in, we schedule migration tasks with customer success.
celine: Telemetry: require deprecation-header rate, unknown-enum spikes, semantic-diff-rate, token-cost-delta. If unknown-enum spikes > 0.5% for 1h, auto-roll back for affected tenants.
nav: Implementation notes: provide SDK helpers to map enums and a compatibility-mode flag in SDKs to ease customer migration. Also include a compatibility-mode lint tool that flags unsafe patterns.
ops-bot: ci-bot: integration job compatibility-matrix started. Tests: schema-lint, enum-tolerance, semantic-diff-check (15m).
omar: Runbook sketch:
1) deploy shim to canary -> mirror production requests to v2 for 48h
2) validate semantic-diff and unknown-enum metrics
3) open opt-in flag for a small tenant cohort (non-critical)
4) ramp cohort over 7d -> 30d observation window
5) schedule migration for remaining tenants + CS outreach
Commands:
```bash
# enable opt-in for tenant
./ffctl set transform-rpc-migration tenant-204 opt_in=true
# show unknown enum counts
./telemetryctl query "unknown_enum.count by tenant"
```
peter: Edge cases: third-party connectors that expect exact payload ordering or rely on side-effect timing. We'll keep a strict compatibility test for connectors and mark unsafe connectors as "manual migration required".
nav: Data-plane concerns: avoid double-processing during mirror. Mirror must be read-only and idempotent. Shim should not write to downstream systems during mirror phase.
celine: Tech-debt paydown policy: mark endpoints deprecated in docs and console. After 90 days of < 0.01% usage and no opt-ins, archive and delete RPC handlers after a 30-day safety hold. Keep a changelog entry for each deletion.
product-bot: Product: we'll add a migration panel in the console showing opt-in status, estimated effort, and billing-preview. Also push a banner for soft-deprecation.
qa-bot: QA note: create synthetic tenants to exercise unknown-enum paths and side-effect connectors. We need ~12 permutations.
omar: Action items:
- Peter: contract test matrix + enum-mapping doc (ETA 3d)
- Nav: SDK helper + lint tool PR (ETA 5d)
- Ops: shim canary + CI job (ETA 2d)
- QA: synthetic permutations + regression hooks (ETA 4d)
- Product: console migration panel mockups (ETA 6d)
celine: I'll book a 30-min check-in in 3 days to review tests and canary metrics. Thanks all.
ops-bot: calendar-bot: Meeting created: Transform-RPC deprecation follow-up 1899991230 at 2024-09-12 09:00 PDT
product-bot: :thumbsup: will coordinate CS outreach for tenants lagging migration.
